**New component: `GroupToModelObjectComponent`** — the reverse of `ModelObjectToGroupComponent`

- **Input**: Single `GH_GeometryGroup` (`Param_Group`, nickname `"Gr"`)

- **Nickname**: `"Gr→Mo"` (mirrors `"Mo→Gr"`)
- **Logic**: Recursively traverses the group hierarchy and extracts all leaf geometry, wrapping each as a `RhinoModelObjectData` via the Rhino document

**Supporting changes:**
- Added `Utility.ExtractRhinoModelObjectDataFromGeometryGroup()` (public) + `ExtractRhinoModelObjectDataFromGeometricGoo()` (private recursive helper) in [Semio.Grasshopper.cs](semio/gh/Semio.Grasshopper/Semio.Grasshopper.cs)
- Added `GroupToModelObjectComponentTests` in [Tests.cs](semio/gh/Semio.Grasshopper.Tests/Tests.cs)
- Updated `NamingConventionTests` to exclude `ScriptingComponent` subclasses, since they use descriptive arrow-style nicknames intentionally rather than the 3-char entity component convention
